objective: The shared work-lifecycle persistence plane's convergence proofs cannot be deleted in silence. A raw filtered cargo test exits 0 when its filter selects zero tests, so a renamed or removed module read as green while the daemon suite stayed green around it; this binds the plane's own tests by exact name, fail-empty and source-bound, and composes the live GoalRun journey into the same command.
falsifiable_claim: 38 pinned names -- 13 in work_lifecycle_routes and 25 in the runtime_work_lifecycle_log kernel core -- each exist as a fn in a pinned source file, are listed exactly by cargo test -- --list --exact with no missing and no extra and never empty, and pass with passed == pinned, 0 failed and 0 ignored. Four source pins hold: exactly five durable-family namespaces, exactly five distinct event-stream op kinds, exactly ZERO calls to persist_record/read_record_dir, and the bounded GoalRun binding sentence. The live plane verifier runs as the population's supplementary and must exit 0.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: The driver's own self-drill plants three defects and requires each to be refused: a pinned test name with no matching fn in the pinned source, a name whose fn exists but whose module path cannot be listed, and an empty population. All three were refused. The population additionally states its durability claim as a measured ABSENCE rather than a guessed call count: the first draft pinned admit_event_stream_operation at 2, the driver reported 6 (one doc comment, three production sites, two test sites), and the pin was replaced with zero calls to persist_record/read_record_dir -- a count that moves whenever a test is added would have said nothing about the path that must not return. The live half is composed rather than cited, because a name-pinned population proves the tests still exist and pass and proves nothing about the plane answering over a real daemon.
remaining_nonclaims: This is a PIN, not new behaviour. The plane was closed for its integrity/replay core in 2026-08; nothing here changes what the plane does, and no daemon or kernel source was modified.
The per-dimension reservation/allocation transaction is M04.10's and no test in this population covers it.
Hosted OutcomeRoom creation and binding remain M04.7's claim.
Pinning 38 names asserts those tests exist and pass. It does not assert that they are sufficient: a convergence property nobody wrote a test for is not covered by pinning the tests that exist.

The CI binding adds an ioi-services --lib test-harness compile to build_and_test, which that job does not otherwise pay. The rust_library_suite_floor job measured that suite at 244.8 s on a warm target; the actual marginal cost in CI is not measured here and the next push is what proves it.
